title: Slayers Royal 2
native_title: スレイヤーズろいやる２
overview:
That self-proclaimed (?) beautiful genius sorceress is back again!!

- Once again, a brand-new title supervised by original author Hajime Kanzaka!
- New characters appear, and Lina and company go wilder than ever!!
- Scenes with the regular voice cast giving it their all!!
- 3D battles that are more strategic and easier to play!

Impostors of Lina & Gourry have appeared!?

あの、自称（？）美少女天才魔道士が再びやってくる！！

◆今回も原作者の神坂一監修でもぎたての新作！
◆新キャラ登場でリナたちもますます暴れまくり！！
◆レギュラー声優陣ノリまくりの大熱演シーン！！
◆より戦略的に楽しめて遊び易くなった3Dバトル！

リナ＆ガウリイのニセ者が現れた！？
